hints.click_to_edit: Click to edit · Enter saves · Esc reverts
hints.drag_to_resize: Drag to resize · double-click to reset

toolbar.search_placeholder: Search by title, repo, agent, or #id
toolbar.blocked_title: Only cards an unfinished dependency holds
toolbar.needs_you_title: Only this board's cards waiting on a person: a question, an approval, or a run that failed, stopped or did not start
toolbar.mode_nested_sub: Subtasks show as rows inside their parent card.
toolbar.mode_cards_sub: Each subtask is a card in the column of its stage.
toolbar.group_stage_sub: One section per stage, in the flow's order.

kbd.move_columns: Move across columns (drop on any stage)
kbd.resolve_thread: Resolve or reopen the focused thread
kbd.pick_up: Pick up the card; arrows move it, Space drops it, Esc cancels

new_task.title: New task

hints.board: (the task appears in its first column)
hints.repos: (optional — agents that need a repo will block until you link one)
hints.type: (decides which columns this task passes through)

placeholders.title: Short title
placeholders.body: Describe the task — context, constraints, acceptance

new_task.no_projects_html: No projects yet — task will be created without a linked repo. Create one if your agent needs it.
new_task.clone_failed: Not offered because their clone failed: {projects}.

board_note.here: {projects}: the tasks go to {board}. This one will be created on {current}, the board you have open.

lightbox.no_preview: No preview available for this file type.

force_pr.no_projects: Force PR: nothing to do — task has no linked projects
force_pr.no_token: Force PR: project "{name}" has no GitHub credential. Pick one in Project → Repository → GitHub access.
force_pr.no_secrets_store: Force PR: no secrets store configured on the daemon.
force_pr.bad_remote: Force PR: repo URL for "{name}" is not a recognized GitHub remote.
force_pr.project_missing: Force PR: project "{name}" cannot be loaded: {error}
force_pr.open_failed: Force PR: GitHub rejected the PR for "{name}": {error}
force_pr.already_open: Force PR: every linked repo already has a PR.

toasts.copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard
toasts.unarchived: The task is back on the board

live.picked: Picked up {title} in {stage}. Left and right move it, Space drops it, Esc cancels.
live.edge: {stage} is the end of this task's flow.

confirm.fork_running_message: Snapshots the current state. Anything the live agent produces afterwards stays in the original.
confirm.delete_task_message: Removes the task and cleans up its worktrees. This cannot be undone.
confirm.finish_parent_message: Open subtasks stay on the board and keep committing to the shared branch.
confirm.delete_subtask_message: Its commits stay on the shared branch. This cannot be undone.
confirm.retry_after_audit_message: The auditor stopped the last run. Its feedback is in Reports; read it before the agent tries again.

test_cases.delete_message: "{title}" will be removed. The videos and files the runs point at stay on the task.

delete_message_runs.one: "{title}" and its {count} run will be removed. The videos and files the runs point at stay on the task.
delete_message_runs.other: "{title}" and its {count} runs will be removed. The videos and files the runs point at stay on the task.

test_cases.import_failed: Could not import the body's test cases: {error}
test_cases.report_gone: That report is no longer on this task
test_cases.not_found: This task has no test case {key}
test_cases.run_url_invalid: Enter a URL that starts with http:// or https://.

run_started.one: Asked {agent} to run {count} case. Follow it in the activity.
run_started.other: Asked {agent} to run {count} cases. Follow it in the activity.

test_cases.section_removed: The Test Cases section left the body.
test_cases.pass_unrun_message: Nobody has run this case yet. Mark it passed only if you tested it yourself.

approvals.delete_message: The approval and its decision leave the task. The agent no longer waits on it.
approvals.note_needed_changes: Write what has to change first
approvals.note_needed_waive: Write why it can be skipped first

questions.cancel_message: The agent gets no answer. If it was waiting on it, the task stays parked until someone moves or relaunches it.

merge.title: Merge into
merge.note: Lands {branch} on {target}: a fast-forward when {target} hasn't moved, otherwise a merge commit. Nothing is written if a file conflicts.
merge.up_to_date: {target} already has every commit of the task

conflicts.one: 1 file conflicts with {target}; nothing was merged:
conflicts.other: {count} files conflict with {target}; nothing was merged:

merge.redo_done: Copy created: it starts from {branch} and lists the files that collided
merge.returned: Comment added with the files. A run working on the task gets it now; otherwise the next run reads it.

archived.title: Archived
archived.empty: Nothing archived. Archive takes a task off the board and keeps its history.

readonly.board: Your role in this workspace is viewer: you can see tasks, but not create, move or change them.
readonly.menu: Your role can only read this workspace.
readonly.comments: Your role can only read this workspace: you can't comment on or edit the task.

list.label: Board tasks
list.empty: This board has no tasks yet.
list.save_failed: Couldn't save the view to your account: {error}. This browser keeps it.
